# cdk-service-host-module-go

Generated Go bindings for [`cdk-service-host-module`](https://github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module). This package lets Go CDK consumers import the shared service host constructs without maintaining a separate implementation.

**Do not hand-edit the files under `cdkservicehostmodule/`.** They are generated by `jsii-pacmak` from the TypeScript source and will be overwritten on the next release.

## Start Here

- [`sc-cdk-service-host-module`](https://github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module) — TypeScript source of truth
- [`sc-ec2-go-service`](https://github.com/Bh-an/sc-ec2-go-service) — real Go consumer and operator repo
- [`cdkservicehostmodule/README.md`](https://github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module-go/tree/main/cdkservicehostmodule) — generated package-level defaults and tables

## Prerequisites

For consuming the module:

- Go

For maintainers regenerating the wrapper:

- Go
- access to the source repo workflow in `sc-cdk-service-host-module`

Quick local verification:

```bash
cd cdkservicehostmodule
go build ./...
```

## Go Module

```bash
go get github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module-go/cdkservicehostmodule@v0.3.2
```

The generated package lives at:

```text
cdkservicehostmodule/
```

<details>
<summary>Usage example</summary>

```go
import (
    "github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module-go/cdkservicehostmodule"
)

cdkservicehostmodule.NewPublicServiceHost(stack, jsii.String("MyService"), &cdkservicehostmodule.PublicServiceHostProps{
    ServiceName:    jsii.String("my-service"),
    DockerImage:    jsii.String("ghcr.io/my-org/my-image:latest"),
    Infrastructure: &cdkservicehostmodule.ServiceInfrastructureProps{
        Vpc:             vpc,
        SubnetSelection: &awsec2.SubnetSelection{SubnetType: awsec2.SubnetType_PUBLIC},
    },
})
```

</details>

## Exposed Constructs

| Construct | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `PublicServiceHost` | Internet-facing EC2 host with module-managed EIP |
| `PrivateServiceHost` | VPC-internal EC2 host, no public endpoint |

Both constructs share the same runtime behavior: Nginx on the host reverse-proxying to a Docker container on a bridge network. Defaults are documented in the [source repo README](https://github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module#configured-defaults).

## Regeneration

Bindings are regenerated from the TypeScript source whenever a new version is released:

1. changes land in [`sc-cdk-service-host-module`](https://github.com/Bh-an/sc-cdk-service-host-module)
2. `npm run package:go` produces `dist/go/cdkservicehostmodule/`
3. that output replaces `cdkservicehostmodule/` in this repo
4. `go mod tidy` and `go build ./...` verify the result

The release workflow automates this; tagging the source repo triggers the release flow here.

## Tagging

This repo requires two tags per release:

| Tag | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `v0.3.2` | Repository-level tag |
| `cdkservicehostmodule/v0.3.2` | Go module subdirectory tag |

Without the subdirectory tag, `go get cdkservicehostmodule@v0.3.2` will fail.
